name: Swap_Ammo
display_fullname: Mission Maker Attacks Dual Pistols Swap Ammo
display_help: You are able to swap out the ammunition your weapon uses by using this power. Swapping out your ammunition will change your secondary damage type on most Dual Pistol attacks from lethal (Standard Rounds), cold (Cryo Rounds), fire (Indendiary Rounds) or toxic (Chemical Rounds). You can cycle through your ammunition by clicking on this power. The first press will change your ammo from Standard to Cryo, the second will change the ammo from Cryo to Incendiary, the third press will change from Incendiary to Toxic, and the fourth press will return your ammo back to Standard. Different ammo types also have different secondary effects. Examine your Dual Pistol powers for more information.
